name: Notify — verified-delivery notification surface
description: Salvages chuck-notify.mjs (375 LOC ledger-only CLI) into a typed plugin that ALSO dispatches when requested. Default behavior matches the .mjs (write the chuck-v3.notification-ledger/1 entry only). With dispatch=true, also sends via the openclaw-bound channel: telegram (HTTP API call as the openclaw bot, to the openclaw-bound chat from openclaw.json#channels.telegram) + apple-bridge desktop banner (osascript). Returns per-channel delivery receipt so callers see real ok/failure, not just ledger-write success.

ledgerRoot.label: Ledger root
ledgerRoot.help: Where chuck-v3.notification-ledger/1 entries land. Each YYYYMMDD sub-dir holds notif_<ts>_<rand>.json files. Same path as chuck-notify.mjs writes.

openclawConfigPath.label: openclaw.json path
openclawConfigPath.help: Where the Telegram bot token + chat allowlist live (channels.telegram block). Defaults to ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json.
